findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_airport" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "sky" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_metar, get_taf, decode_metar_taf, lookup_airport, get_airport_delays, get_space_weather, asteroid_close_approaches, sun_moon_times, get_satellite_image, get_weather · Public sink: get_airport_delays.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_metar, get_taf, decode_metar_taf, lookup_airport, get_airport_delays, get_space_weather, asteroid_close_approaches, sun_moon_times, get_satellite_image, get_weather · Public sink: get_airport_delays

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
